case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment's caption: Harpal Singh @ Chhota v. State of Punjab.

number_of_accused.quote: Though eight persons including the appellants were indicted...
number_of_accused.reason: Six were convicted, but eight were indicted; the value omits the indicted count.

accused_gender.quote: the appellant Sukhmeet Singh alleged political vendetta... which belonged to his father
accused_gender.reason: Accused are male, supported by male pronouns for the appellants and their fathers.

accused_age.reason: The judgment gives no age for any accused.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Occupation is stated only for co-accused Sukhmeet (Municipal Councillor), not Harpal; treated as not stated for the appellant.

accused_socioeconomic_status.reason: Socioeconomic status of the accused is not stated.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.quote: Gagan Kumar son of Subhash Mahendru
victim_gender.reason: The victim is male, identified as the son of PW2.

victim_age.reason: The victim's age is not given anywhere in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.correct_value: Largely strangers; victim knew Sukhmeet only as a Municipal Councillor, not personally; Harpal previously unknown; lured via a land deal
accused_victim_relationship.quote: he did not know him prior to the incident
accused_victim_relationship.reason: Stranger is broadly right for Harpal, but the judgment notes some prior acquaintance with Sukhmeet and a land-deal lure.

offence_category.quote: kidnapped one Gagan Mahendru... most probably for extracting ransom
offence_category.reason: Kidnapping for ransom matches the charges and facts.

statutory_provisions.correct_value: IPC ss.364A, 395, 412, 471, 120B; Arms Act s.25 (Harpal Singh only)
statutory_provisions.quote: convicted under Sections 364A, 395, 412, 471, 1208 IPC and the appellant-Harpal Singh @Chhota ... also under Section 25 of the Arms Act
statutory_provisions.reason: Omits the Arms Act s.25 conviction for Harpal Singh.

weapon.quote: a point .32 revolver belonging to the victim... country made pistol with live cartridges
weapon.reason: Firearms, revolver and iron chains are all supported.

evidence_type.correct_value: Eyewitness (victim); recovery/disclosure evidence; lender and father testimony; call details (held inadmissible)
evidence_type.quote: the only eye witness to the actual act of abduction is the victim himself
evidence_type.reason: No medical evidence or dying declaration is mentioned; call details were excluded.

confession.correct_value: No confession stated; Section 27 disclosure statements led to recoveries
confession.quote: the disclosures made by the accused persons leading to the recoveries and seizures are indeed relevant facts
confession.reason: Disclosure statements under Section 27 are discussed, which the value does not mention.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: under the threat of being killed by them... ransom
aggravating_circumstances.reason: Threat to life, ransom demand and firearm use are all supported.

mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are stated in the judgment.

high_court_outcome.quote: the affirmation of their conviction by the High Court
high_court_outcome.reason: The High Court affirmed the conviction; 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

final_outcome.quote: The appeals thus fail and are dismissed.
final_outcome.reason: Supreme Court dismissed the appeals, upholding conviction.

offence_finally_established.quote: the prosecution has been able to prove the charges levelled against the appellants
offence_finally_established.reason: Abduction for ransom and conspiracy are the proved offences.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Not stated for Harpal Singh (sentences ranged from one year to life)
imprisonment_type.quote: awarded sentences ranging from one year to imprisonment for life
imprisonment_type.reason: The judgment gives no specific sentence type for this appellant.

imprisonment_years.quote: ranging from one year to imprisonment for life
imprisonment_years.reason: No 15-year term appears; the range given is one year to life.

fine_rs.reason: No specific fine amount is stated; null is appropriate.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Victim abducted from a Honda City car, tied with chains, threatened with death for two days, released after ransom; recoveries and victim identification at trial
neutral_facts.quote: he was threatened to be killed with his revolver
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are largely accurate, but 'interrogated by the abductors' is not stated in the judgment.

offence_severity.correct_value: One year to imprisonment for life, and fine commensurate
offence_severity.quote: awarded sentences ranging from one year to imprisonment for life and fine commensurate therewith
offence_severity.reason: The '3 years' lower bound is not in the judgment; the stated minimum is one year.

attempt_completion.quote: the victim was dropped at Nakodar Chowk
attempt_completion.reason: The abduction and ransom demand were carried out to completion.

physical_harm.correct_value: Victim tied with chains, blindfolded, drugged, threatened with death
physical_harm.quote: put on chains on his hands and feet and was blindfolded as well... Later, he was drugged
physical_harm.reason: Threat alone omits the physical restraint, blindfolding and drugging described.

number_of_offences.quote: two out of the six persons, convicted... eight persons including the appellants were indicted
number_of_offences.reason: Eight indicted and six convicted is supported.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Ransom demanded (Rs 1 crore or more) and paid in cash; Rs 15,000 cash and a revolver taken from the victim
financial_property_loss.reason: Ransom money and the victim's cash and revolver were taken, so 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

premeditation_planning.quote: the perpetrators did not betray any haste... designedly took their time to strike at the opportune moment
premeditation_planning.reason: Court found deliberate build-up steps as part of the conspiratorial scheme.

motive.quote: abduction of the victim for realisation of ransom
motive.reason: Financial motive of ransom is supported.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: Evidence of victim as a whole was truthful
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the headnote and court's acceptance of victim and recovery evidence.

witness_credibility.quote: The evidence of the victim (PW 1) as a whole, in our estimate, is truthful
witness_credibility.reason: Victim's truthfulness and corroboration by father and lenders are supported.

post_offence_conduct.reason: No post-offence conduct of the accused is discussed.

custody_duration.quote: captivity of a period of almost two days
custody_duration.reason: Captivity of almost two days is stated.

trial_duration.correct_value: Offence 09.01.2008 (FIR 11.01.2008); High Court judgment 21.04.2014; Supreme Court judgment 21.11.2016; trial court judgment date not stated
trial_duration.quote: the High Court of Punjab and Haryana... dated 21.04.2014
trial_duration.reason: 21.04.2014 is the High Court date, not the trial judgment date.

legal_representation.quote: Subromaniam Prasad, R. Basant, Sr. Advs... V. Madhukar, AAG
legal_representation.reason: Named counsel for appellants and State match the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: charge-sheet under Sections 364A, 392, 395... was laid against the accused persons
investigation_status.reason: FIR, charge-sheet and completed trial are supported.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Call details held inadmissible for lack of Section 65B(4) certificate; no TIP held; general s.313 examination
procedural_irregularity.quote: the prosecution has failed to adduce a certificate relatable thereto as required under Section 65B(4)
procedural_irregularity.reason: Court identified irregularities, including missing certificate and no TIP, so 'None noted' is contradicted.

appeal_history.correct_value: Trial court convicted and sentenced; High Court affirmed; Supreme Court dismissed appeals
appeal_history.quote: the conviction and sentence recorded by the Trial Court have been sustained
appeal_history.reason: Trial court convicted rather than 'upheld'; the rest of the appeal chain is correct.

prosecution_argument.quote: the prosecution has been successful in substantiating the involvement of the accused persons
prosecution_argument.reason: Summary of the State's arguments on victim evidence and recoveries is supported.

defence_argument.correct_value: Defence argued absence of TIP made identity unproved and victim's late naming was fatal
defence_argument.quote: in absence of the TIP, their identity, as participants in the offence, has also remained unproved
defence_argument.reason: 'TIP' is a test identification parade, not a 'Taluka Police Inspector'; that expansion is invented.

legal_principle_applied.quote: conspiracy requires an act i.e. actus reus and an accompanying mental state i.e. mens rea
legal_principle_applied.reason: Accurately states the conspiracy principles applied by the court.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Anvar P. V. v. P.K. Basheer... relied on
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Listed authorities match those cited, including those merely referred to.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the prosecution has been able to prove the charges levelled against the appellants
sentencing_rationale.reason: Rationale for upholding conviction and sentence matches the judgment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: The court identifies no mitigating factors.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: The court does not expressly list aggravating factors for sentencing.

other_sentence_order.quote: It has been ordered that all the sentences would run concurrently.
other_sentence_order.reason: The judgment expressly orders concurrent sentences, contradicting 'None'.
